name: ESP32 DevKit V1 (DOIT, 30-pin)
description: The ubiquitous $4-5 30-pin ESP32 devkit: WROOM-32 module, USB-UART bridge, EN/BOOT buttons and a blue LED; the cheapest classic ESP32 with Bluetooth Classic and DACs.
notes: 30-pin (2x15) version of the DOIT design: GPIO0 is not broken out and GPIO6-11 (flash) are absent, leaving 25 GPIOs. Many clones have 38 pins (DevKitC-like): count pins before buying.
USB-UART is CP2102 or CH340 depending on the batch (CH340 needs a driver on some OSes). Blue LED on GPIO2.
Some clones lack auto-reset and need BOOT held (or a ~10 uF cap EN-GND) during upload. GPIO34-39 are input-only; ADC2 is unusable while Wi-Fi is active.
Dimensions vary slightly between clone batches (about 51-55 mm long).
